integrity: A mathematical proof and a finite reproducible verifier are provided. Finite enumeration is supporting evidence and is not an infinite proof; originality is a best-knowledge assessment and independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Full permutation arches in exactly two phases only; standard greedy and rearrangement tools not novel. No all-word optimization, multistage theorem or independently verified literature uniqueness is asserted. Equivalence in unlocated literature remains possible.
title: One-switch permutation arches: exact shortest-absent spectra and sharp order extrema
